name: Style Transfer Function (1D)
definition: A technique for illustrative volume rendering that maps data values and surface normals to color and opacity using three separate textures (transfer, index, style) to avoid the high storage requirements of a single 3D texture while allowing interpolation between discrete styles.
summary: A Style Transfer Function (1D) maps scalar values and normals to color and shading styles using lit sphere maps, avoiding high storage costs by storing discrete styles separately.
